title: Angel

A custom origin created for the mod of the same name adding the "Angel" origin to play with.

body:
Angel

#

**Inspired by Angels from Evangelion**  
Should work in multiplayer although the possible lag from custom particles hasn't been tested in a server.

##

💟  - Soul  
**Your abstract being, and the source of the invisible boundary of all lifeforms.**  
-> Passive energy and lifeline you accumulate. Used to power all A.T field related abilities.
Your soul powers an ever-present A.T Field that is your sole mean of defense. Running out of it means exposing yourself, leaving but the capacity of handling a single blow before annihilation.  
**You have only one heart, and damage is translated as Soul damage until you run out of Soul. When Running out of soul, it takes a few seconds to properly regenerates an A.T Field.
May notice spikes of Soul during critical situations.**

🔶 - A.T Field - Shield //Active//   
**The barrier of the heart, manifested.**  
->  Materializes your A.T field into a physical forcefield that pushes nearby entities. Doing so drains soul.

🔶 - A.T Field - Beam //Active//   
**The barrier of the heart, condensed and given an offensive usage. Some would call this enlightnement.**  
-> Materializes your A.T field into a single energy point of high density toward a target, exploding into a cross. Doing so uses an heavy amount of soul, and has a cooldown.

🔶 - A.T Field  - Glide //Toggle//   
**The barrier of the heart, manifested as to alleviate your movements.**  
-> Materializes your A.T field below you as to slow your fall and allow you to glide in the air. Doing so drains soul.

🔶 A.T Field - Psychose //Active//    
**The barrier of the heart, infiltrating another's.**  
-> Manipulates your A.T field into a psychic area, infiltrating any other caught entity's psyche, removing any will to fight from them for a bit. Doing so uses an heavy amount of soul, and has a cooldown.

🟠 - Impact [✝️]   
**A last wailing before extinction.**  
-> On death, all your energy releases into a single burst of pure power bringing salvation to all and any entities in a gigantic radius, leaving but a cross where their body once rested, if death was the only exit for them.  
**Only active once "To learn from humanity" has been maxed. Has a 30min cooldown. (Radius is 128 blocks with 40 damage by default).**

🟠  - To learn from humanity [🧠]  
**Understanding is evolution.**  
-> You cannot wear any form of physical armor, nor use a shield, as it incapacitates you. Despite this, you can expand your core and fulfillement by learning from those who once progressed through this world.  
**Completing specific advancements permanentely upgrades your Soul capacity. (Smelt iron, enter the nether, kill the ender dragon, summon a wither, explore all biomes)**

🟠  - Kin of humanity [🧍]  
**Born from the opposite being, yet similar in nature.**  
-> Take increased damage from all humanoid entities, but take decreased damage from all non-humanoid entities.

🔴 - Carnal drive [🍖]  
**The compulsion to live.**  
-> Your instinctive drive pushes you to only crave flesh, making you uneable to eat anything else.

###

This origin is for now meant to work with fabric on 1.20.1, it might work on later version but the pack.mcmeta number has to be manually changed.

**Origin by devotedmiau**
